title: QuantReflex Report
description: Canonical schema for user-submitted reports in the QuantReflex ecosystem (ADR-096). Written SERVER-SIDE ONLY by main-app POST /api/report (Admin SDK) and read by the Super-Admin Reports dashboard via /api/admin/reports (Admin SDK). Clients never touch the 'reports' collection directly (firestore.rules: all-deny). Enums are the source of truth in shared/constants/report-types.js; both API handlers keep an inline copy (Vercel bundles per-app root, so ../shared cannot be required at runtime) and scripts/report.check.js asserts lockstep. Reports are fully self-contained in Firestore — NO email / external notification (the dashboard is the source of truth). Screenshots/attachments are intentionally NOT part of v1; the schema leaves a migration-free seam (see 'attachments' note under 'question' and the reports/{id}/attachments/* subcollection reserved in FIRESTORE_BLUEPRINT).

id.description: Firestore auto-ID of this report (mirrored into the doc for client-free reference).

shortId.description: Human-friendly reference shown to the reporter and admins (crypto-random base32, e.g. 'QR-8F3K'). Not guaranteed globally unique but collision-resistant enough for support conversations.

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 creation timestamp (readers normalize number|ISO|Timestamp|Date per FIRESTORE_BLUEPRINT).

createdAtMs.description: Epoch-ms creation time. Primary sort/range key (createdAtMs DESC) and the field used by the per-uid rate-limit / dedupe window query.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 of the last admin mutation (status/assign/priority/label/note/merge). Equals createdAt at creation.

questionSignature.description: Top-level mirror of question.signature (null for non-drill reports). Indexed so the dashboard can list all reports for one generator ('reported N times') and drive the questionReports aggregate.

reporter.description: Identity of the submitting user — assembled SERVER-SIDE from req.userId + resolved auth (never trusted from the client body).

uid.description: Firebase Auth uid of the reporter (from the verified ID token).

plan.description: Entitlement at report time (server-resolved via aiService.resolveUserAuth).

classification.description: What the report is about + how the user described it.

type.description: Report type. In-drill entry pre-selects the question-family types; Settings offers all.

subReason.description: Optional type-specific refinement (e.g. visual→'chart_wrong', payment→'refund'). Validated against report-types.js subReasons for the type.

description.description: Free-text body (or in-drill note). Length-capped per FIELD_LIMITS.

priority.description: Triage priority. Auto-seeded from the type's defaultPriority at create time; admin-editable afterwards.

fields.description: Raw type-specific structured fields captured by the modal (e.g. bug: expected/actual/repro; feedback: rating). Optional; each string capped per FIELD_LIMITS. Kept as a bag so new per-type fields need no schema migration.

lifecycle.description: Admin-driven triage state. Created with status:'open' and empty labels/notes; every field here is mutated ONLY by /api/admin/reports (Admin SDK), never the client.

status.description: Lifecycle status. 'open'|'investigating'|'needs_info' count as still-needs-attention (dashboard Open count + questionReports.openCount).

assignedTo.description: adminUid this report is assigned to, or null.

assignedToEmail.description: Email mirror of assignedTo for display.

internalNotes.description: Admin-only note thread. Never shown to the reporter (no reply-to-reporter channel in v1).

context.description: MAXIMIZED auto-collected diagnostics — the primary (and only) debug aid in v1, replacing screenshots. Assembled client-side by ReportContext.collect() and re-validated/size-capped server-side. Schemaless bag by design; adding fields needs no migration.

source.description: Which entry point opened the report: Settings, an in-drill question, or an AI explanation (ADR-097).

device.description: Device / runtime fingerprint (best-effort; unavailable fields omitted).

recentErrors.description: Bounded ring of the most recent window.onerror / unhandledrejection captures (last ~10) from the app error buffer.

submittedAtMs.description: Client clock at submit (may differ from server createdAtMs; useful for offline-queued reports).

question.description: Present ONLY when context.app.source==='drill'. MAXIMIZED snapshot so the exact item is reproducible admin-side without a screenshot. attachments deliberately omitted — a future reports/{id}/attachments/* subcollection (or question.figures[]) adds with zero migration.

questionId.description: Firestore question doc id, if a bank question.

optionFigures.description: Compact per-option figure specs, when present.

answer.description: Correct answer (number or string as rendered).

aiContext.description: Compact AI-explain context bundle (mirrors the drill-engine AI packaging idiom).

chart.description: Size-capped chart/figure spec so the visual can be re-rendered admin-side.

selectedAnswer.description: Raw selected answer at report time (may be null if unanswered).

ai.description: AI explanation metadata (ADR-097) — present only when context.app.source==='ai_explain'. Ties a reported explanation back to its exact generation config so an admin can triage it without reproducing it. null otherwise.

explanation.description: The full AI explanation text the user was looking at.

promptId.description: Prompt id embedding the prompt version, e.g. 'explain.base@3'.

model.description: Model that generated the explanation, e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini' (surfaced in the explain envelope meta).
